findings.body: Changing `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `use openhuman_core as oh` shifts every `oh::...` path in this file from the `openhuman` submodule to the crate root. If the `agent`, `agent::dispatcher`, `agent::prompts`, etc. modules live under `openhuman_core::openhuman` and are not re-exported at the crate root, this will not compile. I cannot see the crate's module layout from the diff, so this is low-confidence — but the consequence if the modules are not at the root is a build break for this file.
findings.title: Verify crate-root module paths after alias change

value.summary: The diff rewrites an import alias from the `openhuman` submodule of `openhuman_core` to the crate root itself; all downstream `oh::agent::...` paths in this file will now resolve against the crate root rather than the `openhuman` submodule, and whether that is valid cannot be determined from the diff alone.
